componentDescription:
Controls a submenu without rendering a DOM element.
Use `MuiMenu2Submenu.defaultProps` to set behavior defaults in the theme.

actionsRef.description:
A ref to imperative actions.

  • unmount: Ends the closing phase of the menu after an externally controlled closing animation finishes. Call preventUnmountOnClose() in onOpenChange first, otherwise the menu completes closing on its own. Whether it leaves the DOM is decided by keepMounted on Menu2SubmenuPopup.
  • close: Closes the menu imperatively when called.

closeParentOnEsc.description: When in a submenu, determines whether pressing the Escape key closes the entire menu, or only the current child menu.

defaultOpen.description:
Whether the menu is initially open.
To render a controlled menu, use the open prop instead.

highlightItemOnHover.description: Whether moving the pointer over items should highlight them. Disabling this prop allows CSS :hover to be differentiated from the :focus (data-highlighted) state.

loopFocus.description: Whether to loop keyboard focus back to the first item when the end of the list is reached while using the arrow keys.

onOpenChange.description: Event handler called when the submenu is opened or closed.

eventDetails.name: eventDetails
eventDetails.description: The reason for the change and the native event.

onOpenChangeComplete.description: Event handler called after the opening or closing animation completes.

open.description: Whether the menu is currently open.
